arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَلْبِسْنِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَجَلِّلْنِي عَـافِيَتَكَ، وَحَصِّنِّي بِعَـافِيَتِـكَ، وَأكْـرِمْنِي بِعَافِيَتِكَ، وَأغْنِنِي بِعَافِيَتِكَ، وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيَّ بِعَافِيَتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa albisni ʿafiyyataka, wajallilni ʿafiyyataka wa ḥassin-ni biʿāfiyatika, wa akrim-ni biʿāfiyatika wa-aghni-ni bi-ʿafiyatika, wa-tasaddaq ʿalayya bi-ʿafiyatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, clothe me in Thy well-being, wrap me in Thy well-being, fortify me through Thy well-being, honour me with Thy well-being, free me from need through Thy well-being, donate to me Thy well-being,

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَأَفْرِشْنِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَلا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ.
transliteration: wa hab li ʿāfiyataka, wa afrishnī ʿāfiyataka wa'aṣliḥ liya ʿāfiyatika, walā tufarriq bayni wa bayna ʿāfiyatika fī al-dunyā wa-l-ākhira
english_text: bestow upon me Thy well-being, spread out for me Thy well-being, set Thy well-being right for me, and separate me not from Thy well-being in this world and the next!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَعَافِنِي عَافِيَةً كَافِيَةً شَافِيَةً عَالِيَةً نَامِيةً، عَافِيَةً تُوَلِّدُ فِي بَدَنِي الْعَافِيَةَ، عَافِيَةَ الدُّنْيَا والآخِرَةِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waʿāfinī ʿāfiyatān kāfiyatān shāfiyatān ʿāliyatān nāmiyatān ʿāfiyatun tuwalidu fī badanīl-ʿāfiyah ʿāfiyat ad-dunyā wal-ākhirati
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make me well with a well-being sufficient, healing, sublime, growing, a well-being that will give birth to well-being in my body, a well-being in this world and the next!

arabic_text: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالأمْنِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِي دِيْنِي وَبَـدَنِي، وَالْبَصِيرَةِ فِي قَلْبِي وَالنَّفَاذِ فِي أمُورِيْ وَالْخَشْيَةِ لَكَ، وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ وَالْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَالاجْتِنَابِ لِمَـا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِـكَ.
transliteration: wa-amnun ʿalayya bis-siḥḥati wal-amni was-salamati fī dīnī wa-badnī walbaṣīrati fī qalbī, wal-nafāḏi fī umūrī, wal-khashyati laka wa al-khawfi minka wa al-qūwwati ʿalā mā amartanī bihi min ṭāʿatika wa al-ijtinābī limā nahaytanī ʿanhu min maʿṣiyatika
english_text: Oblige me through health, security, and safety in my religion and body, insight in my heart, penetration in my affairs, dread of Thee, fear of Thee, strength for the obedience which Thou hast commanded for me, and avoidance of the disobedience which Thou hast prohibited for me!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، وَزِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَرَحْمَتُكَ وَبَرَكَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ، وَآلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
transliteration: allāhumma wamnun ʿalayya bil-ḥajji wal-ʿumrah wa-ziyārati qabri rasūlika ṣalawātuka ʿalayhi wa raḥmatuka wa barakātuka ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa āli rasūlika ʿalayhimu al-salāmu abadan mā abqaytanī
english_text: O God, oblige me through the hajj, the umra, and visiting the graves of Thy Messenger (Thy blessings, mercy, and benedictions upon him and upon his Household) and the Household of Thy Messenger (upon them be peace) for as long as Thou causest me to live,

arabic_text: فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَفِي كُلِّ عَام، وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولاً مَشْكُوراً مَذْكُوراً لَدَيْكَ، مَذْخُوراً عِنْدَكَ،
transliteration: fī ʿāmī hāḏā wa fī kulli ʿām wa-jʿal dhālika maqbūlan mashkūran maẓkūran ladayka mazkhurun ʿindaka
english_text: in this year of mine and in every year, and make that accepted, thanked, and mentioned before Thee and stored away with Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ الثَّناءِ عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي، وَاشْرَحْ لِمَرَاشِدِ دِينِكَ قَلْبِي،
transliteration: wa-antiq bi-hamdika wa-shukrika wa-dhikrika wa-husni ath-thana'i 'alayk lisani wa ashrah limarashidi deenika qalbi
english_text: Make my tongue utter Thy praise, Thy thanksgiving, Thy remembrance, and Thy excellent laudation, and expand my heart toward the right goals of Thy religion!

arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيم وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَالْعَامَّةِ وَاللاَّمَّةِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْطَان مَرِيد ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ سُلْطَان عَنِيد ،
transliteration: wa'a'ithni wa dhurriyyati min ash-shaytanir-rajim wa min sharri al-sāmmati wa al-hāmmati wa al-ʿāmmati wa al-lāmmati wa min sharri kulli shaytanin mareed wa min sharri kulli sultan ʿanid
english_text: Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan, the evil of venomous vermin, threatening pests, swarming crowds, and evil eyes, the evil of "every rebel satan" (22:3), the evil of every refractory sovereign,

arabic_text: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مُتْرَف حَفِيد، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ضَعِيف وَشَدِيد، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَرِيف وَوَضِيع، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ صَغِير وَكَبِير،
transliteration: wa min sharr kulli mutraf ḥafīḍ wa min sharr kulli ḍaʿīf wa shadīd wa min sharri kulli sharīf wa wadhīʿ wa min sharri kulli sagheerin wa kabeer
english_text: the evil of everyone living in ease and served, the evil of everyone weak or strong, the evil of everyone born high or low, the evil of everyone small or great,

arabic_text: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ قَرِيْب وَبَعِيد، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَلأهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبَـاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ، وَمِنْ شَرّ كُلِّ دَابَّة أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
transliteration: wa min sharri kulli qareebin wa baʿeed wa min sharri kulli man nasaba li rasulika wa li ahli baytih harban mina al-jinni wa al-insi wa min sharri kulli dābbah anta ākhidhun bināsiyatiha
english_text: the evil of everyone near or far, the evil of every one, jinn or man, who declares war on Thy Messenger and his Household, and the evil of "every crawling creature that Thou hast taken by the forelock!
Surely Thou art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وآلِهِ وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ، وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ، وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa-man aradani bisuu fasrifhu anni wa-adhar anni makrahu wa-adra' anni sharrahu, wa-rudda kaydahu fi nahrihi wa-j'al bayna yadayhi saddan hatta tu'miya 'anni basarahu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception, avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat, and place before him a barricade, so that Thou mayest blind his eyes toward me,

arabic_text: وَتُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْري سَمْعَهُ، وَتُقْفِلَ دُونَ إخْطَارِي قَلْبَهُ، وَتُخْرِسَ عَنَي لِسَانَهُ، وَتَقْمَعَ رَأسَهُ، وَتُذِلَّ عِزَّهُ، وَتَكْسِرَ جَبَرُوتَهُ، وَتُذِلَّ رَقَبَتَهُ، وَتَفْسَخَ كِبْرَهُ،
transliteration: wa tusimma ʿan dhikri samʿahu, wa tuqfilu dun'a ikhtari qalbahu wa tukhrisa ʿanay lisānahu, wa taqmaʿa raʾsahu wa tuzillu ʿizzahu, wa takṣira jabarūtahu wa tuzillu raqabatahu, wa tafsaḵa kibrāhu
english_text: deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me, silence his tongue against me, restrain his head, abase his exaltation, break his arrogance, abase his neck, disjoint his pride,

arabic_text: وَتُؤْمِنَنِي مِنْ جَمِيْعِ ضَرِّهِ وَشَرِّهِ وَغَمْزِهِ وَهَمْزِهِ وَلَمْزِهِ وَحَسَدِهِ وَعَدَاوَتِهِ وَحَبَائِلِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ وَرَجْلِهِ وَخَيْلِهِ
transliteration: wa tuʾminuni min jamiʿi ḍarrihi wa sharrihi wa ghambzihi wa hamzihi wa lamzihi wa hasadihi waʿadāwatih waḥabāʾilihi wamaṣāʾidihi warajlihi wakhaylihi
english_text: and make me secure from all his injury, his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy, his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!
